messages:
maria gomez: Heads-up: ACME (tenant `acme-corp`) asked for a 6-month audit export, CSV -> s3, retention=180d. Any approval flow or quota blockers today?
ashwin: We currently allow exports via export-service with per-tenant daily byte quota and concurrent job limit. No human approval step or reason capture today.
tess: Console flow today is: Request export -> job queued -> ops can cancel. No approver, no justification. UX is tight but compliance wants an approver + reason.
samir: Proposal: lightweight approval pipeline. Steps: request -> approver (team admin) reviews size & bucket -> approve (or deny). On approve, system returns signed URL and emits audit events linking actor/approver/reason/job. Telemetry events: export.requested, export.reviewed, export.approved, export.denied, export.started, export.completed, export.failed.
maria gomez: Nice. For compliance we need audit fields: actor, approver, timestamp, reason, pii_handling, retention_requested, size_estimate, target_bucket (masked in ui), job_id, audit_event_id. Also need to prove the approver identity even if they delete their user later.
infra-bot: export-service: job=77ab9 created tenant=acme-corp size_est=12GB concurrent_exports=2/3 daily_quota_remaining=88GB
ashwin: API sketch for approval endpoint (minimal):

``` 
POST /v1/admin/exports/{job_id}/approve
Body: {"approver":"<email>", "reason":"<text>", "ttl_hours":72, "pii_handling":"redact|hash|raw"}
Response: {"signed_url":"https://s3...","expires_at":"...","audit_event_id":"evt_..."}
```

We'll persist audit_event_id on the job, and fire a durable event to the audit-log topic.
tess: Security constraints: approver shouldn't be able to select arbitrary buckets. Need allowlist of tenant-owned buckets or tenant-prefix enforcement + KMS key binding. UI should mask bucket names (e.g. s3://*****-exports) unless the viewer has export-read permission. Also we should redact bucket in general audit exports unless requestor has explicit role.
samir: Quota enforcement rules idea: check both daily_bytes_quota and concurrent_jobs. If request > daily quota => auto-deny with export.quota_denied event. If within quota but would exceed concurrent limit => queue with reason or require manual approval. Also return quota hints in headers on approve endpoints: `X-Export-Quota-Remaining: 88GB`, `X-Export-Concurrent-Remaining: 1` so the UI can surface them.
ashwin: Also suggest returning `audit_link` in the response for completed jobs (link to immutable audit view). For long exports, emit heartbeat events: export.progress (bytes_emitted, percent). That helps a dashboard progress bar.
elaine: Console changes: add "Audit Exports" admin table with columns: job_id, tenant, requested_by, approver, status, size_est, created_at, started_at, completed_at, audit_event_id. Add quick filters for approver, status, date range. Add timeline row expansion showing events (requested -> reviewed -> approved -> started -> progress -> finished). Mask bucket by default and show a reveal action if permission allows.
ashwin: PII handling options need a design doc: redact vs hash vs raw. Hash might still be considered PII for some regs, so we need legal input. Create export job metadata field `pii_handling` and include it in audit events.
tess: UX for approval modal: show size_est, estimated duration, bucket (masked), remaining quota, recent export history for tenant, and a free-text justification (required). Approver can set ttl_hours for signed URL; default 72h.
maria gomez: Ownership: backend export-service & telemetry -> @ashwin, console/approval modal -> @tess, security/KMS gating -> security infra (loop in @elaine for UI constraints). Please create JIRA tickets and link here.
ashwin: Will RFC + API docs + migration plan. We'll keep existing automatic exports working; add RBAC checks and an allowlist feature. ETA: RFC by Tue.
elaine: I'll update the dashboard mockups once API shape is stable. Wireframes will include the timeline and progress heartbeats.
samir: One more: exports must be immutable once completed. Export artifacts should have immutable metadata and audit_event_id embedded in object metadata (e.g., s3 object tags: audit_event_id=evt_xxx). That makes downstream forensic checks easier.
tess: We also need to think about retention enforcement: if retention=180d, system should schedule deletion and emit export.expiry_scheduled and export.deleted events (include deletion_timestamp).
maria gomez: Sounds good. Action items: ashwin create RFC + JIRA for PII/KMS; tess implement modal mock; elaine produce dashboard mock; samir add audit event schema to event catalog. We'll review next eng-platform weekly. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: noted: created issue EXPORTS-421 for export-approve-api and EXPORTS-422 for audit-event-schema.
maria gomez: Thanks all.
